official_price_rule: Deep analysis uses scanlite.deep_usable ACTIONABLE-CORE gate. Top10 stale trade timestamps alone do not block analysis; stale candidates are excluded individually and final candidate prices are always rechecked. day_change_pct is previous-close based, not true rolling24h.

scanlite.deep_usable_rule: BTC<=30s + top10 actionable>=5 + unique actionable candidates>=8. Top10 freshness ratios/max-age are warnings, not global blockers; each final candidate price is rechecked before READY.
scanlite.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps. V2.7.2d treats core age/fresh ratios as warnings when BTC and enough actionable candidates are live.

scan.deep_usable_rule: BTC<=30s + top10 actionable>=5 + unique actionable candidates>=8. Top10 freshness ratios/max-age are warnings, not global blockers; each final candidate price is rechecked before READY.
scan.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps. V2.7.2d treats core age/fresh ratios as warnings when BTC and enough actionable candidates are live.

final_price_recheck_top15.rule: selected candidates must be rechecked after deep analysis; abs(scan_to_final_pct)>=1% => price_move_warning
